class.name: IfcConstraintAggregationRelationship
class.brief_description: An IfcConstraintAggregationRelationship is an objectified relationship that enables instances of IfcConstraint subtypes to be aggregated together logically. HISTORY New Entity in IFC Release 2.0. Modified in IFC2x2.
